scope: Static three-model schema acceptance only. No generator source validation, runtime, hardware, build, or legal acceptance.

source_basis.basis: Accepted immutable design v2 and its independent source review. Their hashes are bound here; no new silicon/source qualification is asserted.

schema_findings.addition: Exactly one new LsiSysclk/PeripheralLsiSysclk record and one final optional lsi_sysclk field in ClockLimits/PeripheralClockLimits in each model. No previous record, field, order, width, attribute or comment was altered.
schema_findings.outer_option: Both owned models use serde(default) on Option. Absent and explicit null lsi_sysclk deserialize as None; project serde skips None during serialization. Static metadata uses Option<PeripheralLsiSysclk>. These are static derived-Serde conclusions, not execution results.
schema_findings.required_inner_facts: All 16 present-record fields are required and nonnullable, with no struct/field default, Option, flatten, alias or custom deserializer. Both input record definitions deny unknown fields. Empty/missing are different: empty vectors or strings remain structurally accepted values, while a missing field is rejected.
schema_findings.numeric_domains: Frequency and factory address are u32; supply uses a two-element u16 tuple; temperature uses a two-element i16 tuple; selector elements are u8; RCC IRQ is u16. Rust/Serde representational width does not establish hardware ranges, tuple ordering, positive frequencies, alignment, valid pins, unique roster, IRQ number, or safe shift count.
schema_findings.static_projection: Both owned models have the same ordered 16 names and exact owned types. Static metadata maps Vec<u8> to static u8 slices, Vec<String> to static slices of static str, and String to static str; scalar and tuple types remain identical. Existing metapac stringify uses derived Debug followed by replacement of colon-space-open-bracket with colon-space-ampersand-open-bracket. Every new collection is a direct named field and every string remains a quoted literal under Debug, so the declared projection fits the existing emitter by inspection. No generated-output compile/probe was run.
schema_findings.serialization: The project record macro supplies Serialize/Deserialize and retains declaration order. All present inner values, including zero/empty values, are serialized because no inner skip rule was added. The owned metapac model derives Deserialize/Debug, not Serialize; the static model has no Serde derive.
schema_findings.legacy_wire_compatibility: Old input without lsi_sysclk still fits the new owned models as None. With None, the project serializer omits the new key and retains prior field order; exact byte output was not dynamically tested. The existing outer ClockLimits records do not deny unknown fields, so old permissive readers may ignore a supplied lsi_sysclk; that does not enable the capability or certify new hardware behavior.
schema_findings.rust_api_compatibility: The new public field changes direct struct literals and exhaustive patterns in all three models. Derived Debug/Hash contents and static metadata shape can change even for None. No Rust source, ABI, memory-layout, binary or unconditional serialized-byte compatibility is claimed.
schema_findings.meaning: The record represents source-qualified factory LSI rate bounds and direct-consumer facts, not a runtime cold-admission witness, per-cycle timing certificate, reset-history proof, caller-provided calibration license, or general-family capability.
